subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should QQBot READY and RESUMED immediately replay matching queued deliveries by bypassing normal backoff for the current transport-error predicate, or should that predicate be narrowed or use standard queue timing?
rationale: Source inspection establishes that all choices are mechanically implementable; selecting retry timing changes message-delivery and rate-limit behavior and therefore requires channel and outbound owner intent.

options.title: Narrow immediate replay
options.body: Keep reconnect draining but bypass backoff only for errors that prove no platform send occurred, including the reported outbound-not-configured failure.

options.title: Preserve normal backoff
options.body: Drain matching entries after reconnect with `bypassBackoff: false`, leaving retry timing entirely to the shared queue policy.

options.title: Split reconnect recovery
options.body: Land the capability-aware resolver separately and review the QQBot queue-replay policy in a narrower follow-up.

recommendation.title: Narrow immediate replay
recommendation.body: Keep reconnect draining but bypass backoff only for errors that prove no platform send occurred, including the reported outbound-not-configured failure.

likelyOwner.reason: They explicitly offered to complete this PR's human review and have recent merged QQBot outbound history; Vincent Koc is the strongest shared-resolver counterpart.
